name: Calm Wasp 75
author: cbolson
description: Outlined sky-blue checkbox that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks: On hover, opacity becomes 0.5, text color changes from #127acf to #f33195. Clicking it toggles it: opacity becomes 1. On focus, opacity becomes 0.5, text color changes from #127acf to #f33195.
